pois.name: Rochette
pois.description: Rock core sample site. NASA lists 'Montdenier' (#2, sol 194, 2021-09-06), 'Montagnac' (#3, sol 196, 2021-09-08) from the 'Rochette' feature; rock type: Igneous. First rock cores of the mission, from an igneous rock on the crater floor (Máaz formation, Artuby ridge).
pois.location_method: Perseverance position on sol 180 (last MMGIS waypoint at or before sol 196); rover-scale approximate.

pois.location_method: Perseverance position on sol 248 (last MMGIS waypoint at or before sol 271); rover-scale approximate.

pois.name: Three Forks Sample Depot
pois.description: Area where Perseverance deposited a set of sample tubes on the surface (sample table lists them as 'Sample Depot'), as a backup cache for a future return mission.
pois.location_method: Perseverance position on sol 652 (deposit operations began 2022-12-21); approximate.

pois.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing
pois.description: Touchdown site of the Perseverance rover (18 February 2021) on the Jezero crater floor.
pois.location_method: First rover waypoint in the NASA/JPL MMGIS file (sol 13).

pois.name: Jezero Crater
pois.description: Impact crater about 47.5 km in diameter (IAU) that once held a lake fed by river channels; landing site of the Mars 2020 mission.
pois.location_method: IAU feature centre (USGS Gazetteer, planetocentric +East).

pois.name: Neretva Vallis
pois.description: Valley that breaches the western rim of Jezero; Sun & Stack (2020) interpret the older fan unit as sourced from it.
pois.location_method: IAU feature centre (USGS Gazetteer).

pois.name: Sava Vallis
pois.description: Valley entering Jezero from the north.
pois.location_method: IAU feature centre (USGS Gazetteer).

pois.name: Jezero western fan (delta)
pois.description: Fan-shaped sedimentary deposit at the mouth of Neretva Vallis (mapped as Jezero fan units 1 and 2 by Sun & Stack 2020), interpreted as an ancient river delta (Mangold et al., 2021).
pois.location_method: Centroid of the largest 'Jezero fan 2 unit' polygon, USGS SIM 3464.
